messages:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to clarify owners for the compliance runway work; auditor wants a single contact for audit queries and a point for the HSM validation results.
Liam: I can be the point for the audit queries. I'll own the Q&A traffic. Do we want one owner for both HSM and KMS proofs or separate?
Jorge: Recommend separate. I'll take HSM validation (smoke tests + attestation artifacts). Priya, does that work?
Priya: Yes please, Jorge on HSM. Liam on auditor comms. Anika — can you confirm who on infra will produce the auditlog backfills?
Anika: That's Dana's team. Dana — can you confirm ETA on the auditlog backfill snapshot and whether we can produce a signed digest?
Dana: We have a backfill plan ready; ETA to produce snapshot + digest is end of day Friday (4920002000). Need one small config tweak to loglevels in staging.
Priya: Noted. Jorge, HSM smoke — we originally planned a canary tomorrow at 10am PST. Still good?
Jorge: Canary still on. I'll run the `hsm-smoke.sh` script and post results. Will include `attestation_report.json` and `sig.pem` artifacts.
Liam: I'll add those artifacts to the evidence bundle and hand off to compliance. Where should I drop the bundle? `s3://redwood-compliance/4920001234-evidence/`? ops-bot: Automated note — created presigned upload folder at s3://redwood-compliance/4920001234-evidence/ (expires in 7d).
Anika: FYI the ingest pipeline needs a small schema tweak to accept the `attestation_report.fields.version` field. I opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/847
Priya: Thanks — can someone review the PR today? This blocks the backfill processing.
Dana: I'm on PR review now, will leave comments in 30m.
Liam: Quick heads-up: auditor asked for a mapping table showing which services write to which KMS keys. I can draft this if you can bubble up the service owners.
Jorge: I'll annotate the HSM consumers list and send it to you by EOD.
Priya: Action items recap: Liam = auditor contact + evidence bundle, Jorge = HSM validation + attestation, Dana = auditlog snapshot + digest, Anika = shepherd infra PR review, Priya = compile final owner mapping and submit to the compliance portal.
Anika: If anyone runs the smoke and uploads artifacts, ping `#eng-security` with the S3 path and the trace id so we can link logs.
Liam: Will do. Trace id for tomorrow's HSM canary will be `trace-hsm-492000`.
Priya: Awesome. If anything slips we escalate to the oncall and mark the milestone as "at risk" in the compliance tracker. :thumbsup:
Dana: One blocker: our staging HSM node has a firmware mismatch that might affect the attestation format. I'll try to patch tonight; if it doesn't land, I'll ping infra-ops and we might need to delay the canary.
Jorge: Understood. Keep us posted — if you need me to reformat the attestation artifact I can do that in the evidence bundle.
Priya: Thanks all. Let's reconvene async here after the canary and PR merge.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: HSM canary job `hsm-smoke-job` set for 10:00 PST tomorrow. Logs will be archived to s3://redwood-ops/hsm-canary/492000/
Liam: Thanks bot :rocket:
